title: DNA and hemoglobin binding activities: Investigation of coumarin-thiosemicarbazone hybrids.
authors: Celik, Esra; Meletli, Furkan; Ozdemir, Mucahit; Koksoy, Baybars; Danis, Ozkan; Yalcin, Bahattin
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过光谱实验、分子对接和DFT计算考察香豆素-缩氨基硫脲杂合物与ct-DNA及牛血红蛋白的结合模式，属于小分子-蛋白/DNA互作，非TF-DNA体系，但分子对接方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Coumarin and coumarin-thiosemicarbazone hybrids were synthesized and characterized by various techniques such as FT-IR, (1)H NMR, (13)C NMR, MALDI-TOF-MS spectroscopy, and single crystal X-Ray diffractometer (XRD). The photochemical and photophysical properties of the compounds, such as solvatochromism, solubility, and chemical reactivity, were analyzed using UV-vis spectroscopy in different solvents. Due to the potential biological activities of the synthesized compounds, their binding affinity and mechanisms with calf thymus DNA (ct-DNA) and bovine hemoglobin (BHb) were determined using several useful spectrophotometric and theoretical approaches such as UV-vis absorption and fluorescence spectroscopy, molecular docking, and density functional theory (DFT). The experimental results showed that the compounds exhibited strong binding interactions with DNA and BHb. Additionally, the compounds demonstrated predominantly binding modes, such as intercalation and groove binding with DNA and pi-pi stacking interactions with BHb.To better understand the thermodynamics of these interactions, quenching constants, binding constants, and Gibbs free energy changes (DeltaG degrees ) were calculated. Molecular docking and DFT results supported the experimental data regarding the binding affinity and mechanisms of the compounds to DNA and BHb. Overall, this comprehensive study on coumarin and coumarin-thiosemicarbazone hybrids provides valuable insights into their interaction mechanisms with critical biomolecules, highlighting their potential in therapeutic applications as multifunctional agents.
abstract_zh: 合成了香豆素及香豆素-缩氨基硫脲杂合体，并通过多种技术对其进行了表征，如FT-IR、¹H NMR、¹³C NMR、MALDI-TOF-MS光谱及单晶X射线衍射仪（XRD）。利用紫外-可见光谱在不同溶剂中分析了这些化合物的光化学和光物理性质，如溶剂化显色效应、溶解性和化学反应活性。鉴于所合成化合物的潜在生物活性，采用多种有用的分光光度法和理论方法，如紫外-可见吸收和荧光光谱、分子对接及密度泛函理论（DFT），测定了它们与小牛胸腺DNA（ct-DNA）和牛血红蛋白（BHb）的结合亲和力及机制。实验结果表明，这些化合物与DNA和BHb表现出强烈的结合相互作用。此外，这些化合物主要展示了特定的结合模式，如与DNA的嵌入和沟槽结合，以及与BHb的π-π堆积相互作用。为更好地理解这些相互作用的热力学特性，计算了猝灭常数、结合常数和吉布斯自由能变化（ΔG°）。分子对接和DFT结果支持了关于化合物与DNA和BHb结合亲和力及机制的实验数据。总体而言，这项关于香豆素及香豆素-缩氨基硫脲杂合体的综合研究为其与关键生物分子的相互作用机制提供了宝贵见解，突显了它们作为多功能药物在治疗应用中的潜力。
